page: Microsoft Azure EC32eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEDV6 server family. It is equipped with 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel processor. The instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

For local storage requirements, the server includes a bundled 1890 GB NVMe SSD. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing for integration with high-performance external storage volumes. The configuration does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or onboard GPU hardware, making it a dedicated CPU-and-memory resource.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the EC32eds_v6 offers a dense memory-to-vCPU allocation combined with substantial local NVMe storage, which reduces the need for external disk attachments for temporary data. This hardware profile is suited for memory-intensive workloads, relational database management systems, in-memory caching layers, and data analytics pipelines that require rapid local scratch space.
